extractions.description: As I navigate through oncoming traffic to bypass a parked vehicle in my lane, an unexpected pedestrian steps out from behind them and runs directly across my path.

Adversarial Object: Pedestrian
Behavior: The adversarial pedestrian unexpectedly steps out from behind a parked vehicle in front of the ego lane and runs directly across its path.

Spawn Position: The adversarial agent is initially positioned hidden behind the parked vehicle located at the start of the crossing zone relative to the ego vehicle.
